# Weaver Fintech Presentation Skill

## ⚠️ One-Time Setup (per Claude account)

Before generating any deck, run this setup block to write the logo files to disk:
```javascript
// setup.js — run once per session: node setup.js
// Writes Weaver Fintech logos AND full Axiforma font family to disk.

const fs = require('fs');

// ── LOGOS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LOGO_FULL_B64 = '';
const LOGO_MARK_B64 = '';

// ── AXIFORMA FONT FAMILY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const FONTS = {
  'Axiforma-Black': '',
  'Axiforma-BlackItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Bold': '',
  'Axiforma-BoldItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Book': '',
  'Axiforma-BookItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-ExtraBold': '',
  'Axiforma-ExtraBoldItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Heavy': '',
  'Axiforma-HeavyItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Italic': '',
  'Axiforma-Light': '',
  'Axiforma-LightItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Medium': '',
  'Axiforma-MediumItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Regular': '',
  'Axiforma-SemiBold': '',
  'Axiforma-SemiBoldItalic': '',
  'Axiforma-Thin': '',
  'Axiforma-ThinItalic': '',
};


// ── WRITE FILES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fs.mkdirSync('/home/claude/assets', { recursive: true });
fs.mkdirSync('/home/claude/assets/fonts', { recursive: true });

fs.writeFileSync('/home/claude/assets/image1.svg', Buffer.from(LOGO_FULL_B64, 'base64'));
fs.writeFileSync('/home/claude/assets/image2.svg', Buffer.from(LOGO_MARK_B64, 'base64'));
console.log('✅ Logos written');

for (const [name, b64] of Object.entries(FONTS)) {
  fs.writeFileSync(`/home/claude/assets/fonts/${name}.otf`, Buffer.from(b64, 'base64'));
  console.log(`✅ Font written: ${name}.otf`);
}

console.log('\n✅ Setup complete — logos + 20 Axiforma font files ready.');
console.log('   Logos:  /home/claude/assets/image1.svg, image2.svg');
console.log('   Fonts:  /home/claude/assets/fonts/Axiforma-*.otf');
console.log('\n   ℹ️  Font note: pptxgenjs embeds font names as strings.');
console.log('   Recipients must have Axiforma installed to see it correctly.');
console.log('   After opening in PowerPoint: File → Options → Save → Embed fonts.');
```

Photos are loaded from GitHub raw URLs — no local setup needed for photos.

## How to Use This Skill

1. Read this file completely before writing any code.
2. Run the **Setup block** above to write logo files to disk (once per session).
3. Copy the **Boilerplate** section verbatim as your script starting point.
4. Add slides using the **Slide Recipes** — each is a drop-in code block.
5. Replace placeholder text/data with the user's actual content.
6. Save to `/mnt/user-data/outputs/<filename>.pptx` and run with `node`.
7. Convert to images and visually QA before presenting the file.

**Always produce an editable `.pptx` file. Never flatten to PDF or image.**

## Image Sizing Rules — NEVER STRETCH OR WARP PHOTOS

Always derive render width from the source pixel aspect ratio at h = 7.5":
  `render_w = (pixel_w / pixel_h) × 7.5`
Then right-anchor: `x = 13.33 - render_w`

Pre-calculated render widths at h = 7.5":

| File        | Pixel dimensions | render_w |
|-------------|-----------------|----------|
| image5.png  | 1485 × 1124     | 9.91"    |
| image6.png  | 1033 × 1125     | 6.89"    |
| image7.png  | 1033 × 1125     | 6.89"    |
| image8.png  | 1165 × 1093     | 7.99"    |
| image9.png  |  925 × 1009     | 6.88"    |
| image10.png | 1106 × 1124     | 7.38"    |

**Never use `sizing: { type: 'contain' }` or any auto-fit — always use explicit w/h from the table above.**

## Brand Constants

```javascript
const C = {
  purple:    '875EFA',  // titles, left accent bars, action cards, numbered circles
  lime:      'C4FF00',  // bottom stripe on thank-you, accent tags
  green:     '1DCD86',  // positive deltas, on-track indicators
  blue:      '2A62F5',  // secondary chart series
  black:     '1A1A1A',  // body text, slide numbers, chart axes
  white:     'FFFFFF',
  offwhite:  'F4F4F4',  // chart panel backgrounds, evidence panel fill
  grey:      'DDDDDD',  // chart panel borders, divider lines
  insightbg: 'EFEFEF',  // insight bar background (light grey)
};
const TF = 'Axiforma';   // title font  ← brand font (replaces Aptos Display)
const BF = 'Axiforma';   // body font   ← same family, use fontWeight to differentiate
```

## ⚠️ Font: Axiforma

Axiforma is the Weaver Fintech brand typeface. It is a **licensed font** and must be installed on the machine that opens the generated `.pptx`. PowerPoint will fall back to Calibri if Axiforma is not installed.

**To install for the deck author:**
1. Download the Axiforma font files (.ttf or .otf) from your SharePoint font library.
2. Install them on your machine (double-click the .ttf, click Install).
3. Re-open the generated .pptx — PowerPoint will now render Axiforma correctly.

**To embed for recipients who don't have the font:**
- In PowerPoint: File → Options → Save → check "Embed fonts in the file".
- This increases file size but guarantees correct rendering on any machine.

**Weight mapping (use fontBold + fontFace instead of separate weights):**

| Use | fontFace | bold |
|-----|----------|------|
| Slide titles, divider titles | `'Axiforma'` | `true` |
| Subtitles, body, labels | `'Axiforma'` | `false` |
| Insight bar headline | `'Axiforma'` | `true` |
| Slide numbers, chart labels | `'Axiforma'` | `false` |

---

## ⚠️ MINIMUM FONT SIZE RULE — 14pt FLOOR

**No text on any slide may be smaller than 14pt.** This is a hard brand rule.

This applies to:
- Body copy in all panels and cards
- Evidence point labels
- Insight bar sub-labels and body text
- Chart panel titles
- Stat card labels
- Slide numbers (exception: slide numbers remain 9pt — they are navigation metadata, not content)
- Slide subtitles

### What to do when copy is too long to fit at 14pt:

**ALWAYS rewrite the copy shorter — NEVER reduce below 14pt.**

Specific rules per element:

| Element | Default size | If copy won't fit |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| Slide title (content slides) | 20pt bold | Shorten to ≤ 12 words. Rephrase — remove filler words. |
| Slide subtitle | 14pt italic | Shorten to ≤ 8 words. |
| Insight bar headline | 14pt bold | Shorten to ≤ 20 words. Keep only the "so what" verb and outcome. |
| Insight bar sub-labels | 14pt | Shorten to ≤ 20 words each. Cut qualifiers. |
| Action card body | 14pt | Shorten to 2 punchy sentences max. Cut all throat-clearing. |
| Evidence point text | 14pt | Shorten to 1 sentence. Lead with the number or fact. |
| Stat card label | 14pt | Max 4 words per line, 2 lines max. |
| Chart panel title | 14pt bold | Max 8 words. Cut units to axis labels. |
| Divider title | 46–52pt bold | Shorten to ≤ 2 words per line; use line breaks. |

### Copy rewrite heuristic:
> If a text block requires font size < 14pt to fit its bounding box, that is a signal the copy is too long — not a signal to shrink the font. Rewrite first; layout second.

## Boilerplate (start every script here)

```javascript
const PptxGenJS = require('pptxgenjs');
const fs        = require('fs');
const pptx      = new PptxGenJS();
pptx.layout     = 'LAYOUT_WIDE'; // 13.33" × 7.5"

const C = {
  purple:'875EFA', lime:'C4FF00', green:'1DCD86', blue:'2A62F5',
  black:'1A1A1A', white:'FFFFFF', offwhite:'F4F4F4', grey:'DDDDDD', insightbg:'EFEFEF',
};
const TF = 'Axiforma';  // brand font — must be installed on viewer's machine
const BF = 'Axiforma';  // same family; differentiate weights via bold: true/false

// ── ASSETS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
const LOGO      = '/home/claude/assets/image1.svg';  // written by setup.js
const LOGO_MARK = '/home/claude/assets/image2.svg';  // written by setup.js

const GH = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TheLeroyMeyer/weaver-fintech-skill/main/assets/';

const PHOTOS = {
  title: { path: GH+'image5.png',  w: 9.91 },
  div1:  { path: GH+'image6.png',  w: 6.89 },
  div2:  { path: GH+'image7.png',  w: 6.89 },
  div3:  { path: GH+'image8.png',  w: 7.99 },
  div4:  { path: GH+'image9.png',  w: 6.88 },
  div5:  { path: GH+'image10.png', w: 7.38 },
};

// ── HELPERS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function logoMark(s) {
  s.addImage({ path: LOGO_MARK, x: 12.55, y: 0.08, w: 0.62, h: 0.62 });
}

function slideNum(s, n) {
  // Slide numbers are navigation metadata — 9pt exception to the 14pt floor rule
  s.addText(String(n), {
    x: 12.8, y: 7.25, w: 0.4, h: 0.2,
    fontSize: 9, bold: false, color: C.black, align: 'right', fontFace: BF
  });
}

function slideTitle(s, title, subtitle) {
  // Title: 20pt bold. Subtitle: 14pt italic (14pt floor).
  // If title won't fit at 20pt, SHORTEN THE COPY — do not reduce font size.
  s.addText(title, {
    x: 0.35, y: 0.08, w: 11.7, h: subtitle ? 0.44 : 0.52,
    fontSize: 20, bold: true, color: C.purple, fontFace: TF, wrap: true
  });
  if (subtitle) {
    s.addText(subtitle, {
      x: 0.35, y: 0.54, w: 11.7, h: 0.26,
      fontSize: 14, italic: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF
    });
  }
}

function chartBox(s, x, y, w, h, title) {
  // Chart panel title: 14pt bold (14pt floor).
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x, y, w, h, fill: { color: C.offwhite }, line: { color: C.grey, pt: 1 }
  });
  s.addText(title, {
    x: x+0.14, y: y+0.1, w: w-0.28, h: 0.3,
    fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF
  });
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: x+0.14, y: y+0.42, w: w-0.28, h: 0.012,
    fill: { color: 'CCCCCC' }, line: { color: 'CCCCCC' }
  });
}

function insightBar(s, headline, impl, watch, action) {
  // All insight bar text: 14pt floor.
  // headline: 14pt bold. Sub-labels + body: 14pt.
  // If any text overflows at 14pt, REWRITE SHORTER — do not reduce below 14pt.
  const Y = 5.72, H = 1.78;
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: 0, y: Y, w: 13.33, h: H, fill: { color: C.insightbg }, line: { color: C.insightbg }
  });
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: 0, y: Y, w: 0.07, h: H, fill: { color: C.purple }, line: { color: C.purple }
  });
  s.addText('INSIGHT', {
    x: 0.2, y: Y+0.08, w: 2, h: 0.22,
    fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.purple, fontFace: BF, charSpacing: 2
  });
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: 0.2, y: Y+0.33, w: 13.0, h: 0.012, fill: { color: 'CCCCCC' }, line: { color: 'CCCCCC' }
  });
  s.addText(headline, {
    x: 0.2, y: Y+0.36, w: 13.0, h: 0.38,
    fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF, wrap: true
  });
  [
    { label: 'Strategic implication', body: impl },
    { label: 'Risk or watch point',   body: watch },
    { label: 'Recommended action',    body: action },
  ].forEach(({ label, body }, i) => {
    const cx = 0.2 + i * 4.35;
    s.addText(label, {
      x: cx, y: Y+0.82, w: 4.1, h: 0.22,
      fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF
    });
    s.addText(body, {
      x: cx, y: Y+1.06, w: 4.1, h: 0.6,
      fontSize: 14, color: C.black, fontFace: BF, wrap: true
    });
  });
}

// ── SLIDES GO HERE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// ── SAVE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pptx.writeFile({ fileName: '/mnt/user-data/outputs/FILENAME.pptx' })
  .then(() => console.log('✅ Done'))
  .catch(e => console.error(e));
```

## Slide Recipes

### TITLE SLIDE
**Rules:** Full wordmark top-left. NO logo mark top-right. Photo right-anchored. No slide number.

```javascript
{
  const s = pptx.addSlide();
  s.addImage({ path: LOGO, x: 0.35, y: 0.28, w: 2.5, h: 1.1 });
  s.addText('Presentation Title\nLine Two\nLine Three', {
    x: 0.35, y: 2.0, w: 7.2, h: 2.9,
    fontSize: 44, bold: true, color: C.purple, fontFace: TF, wrap: true
  });
  s.addText('Subheading — max 10 words, rewrite if longer.', {
    x: 0.35, y: 5.1, w: 7.0, h: 0.38,
    fontSize: 16, bold: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF
  });
  s.addText('Month Year', { x: 0.35, y: 5.58, w: 4, h: 0.3, fontSize: 14, color: C.black, fontFace: BF });
  s.addText('weaverfintech.com', { x: 0.35, y: 5.95, w: 4, h: 0.28, fontSize: 14, color: C.black, fontFace: BF });
  const p = PHOTOS.title;
  s.addImage({ path: p.path, x: 13.33 - p.w, y: 0, w: p.w, h: 7.5 });
}
```

---

### DIVIDER SLIDE
**Rules:** Logo mark top-right. Large purple bold title, left side. Photo right-anchored. Slide number bottom-right.
Use `fontSize: 46` for long titles (11+ chars per line), `fontSize: 52` for short titles.
Cycle photos: div1 → div2 → div3 → div4 → div5.

```javascript
{
  const s = pptx.addSlide();
  logoMark(s);
  s.addText('Section\nTitle.', {
    x: 0.35, y: 2.0, w: 5.8, h: 3.2,
    fontSize: 52, bold: true, color: C.purple, fontFace: TF, wrap: true
  });
  const p = PHOTOS.div1;
  s.addImage({ path: p.path, x: 13.33 - p.w, y: 0, w: p.w, h: 7.5 });
  slideNum(s, N);
}
```

### TWO-CHART SLIDE
**Rules:** Logo mark top-right. Purple title + italic subtitle (14pt). Two chart panels. Insight bar. Slide number.
All text ≥ 14pt. Shorten copy before reducing font size.

```javascript
{
  const s = pptx.addSlide();
  logoMark(s);
  slideTitle(s,
    'Title states the finding — max 12 words.',
    'Section Label  |  Time Period'   // max 8 words; 14pt italic
  );

  chartBox(s, 0.2, 0.88, 6.4, 4.72, 'Chart A Title — max 8 words');
  s.addChart(pptx.charts.BAR, [
    { name: 'Series 1', labels: ['Cat1','Cat2','Cat3','Cat4','Cat5'], values: [10,20,30,40,50] },
    { name: 'Series 2', labels: ['Cat1','Cat2','Cat3','Cat4','Cat5'], values: [5,15,25,35,45] },
  ], {
    x: 0.25, y: 1.38, w: 6.3, h: 4.16,
    barGrouping: 'clustered',
    chartColors: ['1A1A1A', C.purple],
    showLegend: true, legendPos: 'b', legendFontSize: 10,
    showValue: true, dataLabelFontSize: 10,
    catAxisLabelFontSize: 10, showTitle: false,
    plotAreaFill: { color: C.offwhite },
  });

  chartBox(s, 6.73, 0.88, 6.4, 4.72, 'Chart B Title — max 8 words');
  s.addChart(pptx.charts.LINE, [
    { name: 'Series A',  labels: ['Cat1','Cat2','Cat3','Cat4','Cat5'], values: [10,20,30,40,50] },
    { name: 'Benchmark', labels: ['Cat1','Cat2','Cat3','Cat4','Cat5'], values: [15,15,20,22,25] },
  ], {
    x: 6.78, y: 1.38, w: 6.3, h: 4.16,
    chartColors: [C.purple, '1A1A1A'],
    showLegend: true, legendPos: 'b', legendFontSize: 10,
    showValue: true, dataLabelFontSize: 10,
    catAxisLabelFontSize: 10, showTitle: false,
    plotAreaFill: { color: C.offwhite },
    lineDataSymbol: 'circle',
  });

  insightBar(s,
    'Key insight — max 20 words, answers "so what?"',
    'Strategic implication — max 20 words.',
    'Risk or watch point — max 20 words.',
    'Recommended action — max 20 words.'
  );
  slideNum(s, N);
}
```

### FOUR-CHART 2×2 GRID SLIDE

```javascript
{
  const s = pptx.addSlide();
  logoMark(s);
  slideTitle(s, 'All four metrics tell a coherent story.', 'Dashboard  |  Period');

  const yrs = ['FY22','FY23','FY24','FY25','FY26'];
  [
    { x: 0.2,  y: 0.88, w: 6.4, h: 2.28, title: 'Metric A — max 6 words', vals: [10,20,30,40,50] },
    { x: 6.73, y: 0.88, w: 6.4, h: 2.28, title: 'Metric B — max 6 words', vals: [5,8,12,18,25]  },
    { x: 0.2,  y: 3.28, w: 6.4, h: 2.28, title: 'Metric C — max 6 words', vals: [80,75,65,55,42] },
    { x: 6.73, y: 3.28, w: 6.4, h: 2.28, title: 'Metric D — max 6 words', vals: [3.1,3.8,5.2,7.4,9.1] },
  ].forEach(({ x, y, w, h, title, vals }) => {
    chartBox(s, x, y, w, h, title);
    s.addChart(pptx.charts.BAR, [{ name: title, labels: yrs, values: vals }], {
      x: x+0.05, y: y+0.5, w: w-0.1, h: h-0.56,
      barGrouping: 'stacked', chartColors: [C.purple],
      showValue: true, dataLabelFontSize: 10, dataLabelColor: C.white,
      catAxisLabelFontSize: 10, showTitle: false,
      plotAreaFill: { color: C.offwhite }, valAxisHidden: true,
    });
  });

  insightBar(s,
    'Headline that unifies all four charts — max 20 words.',
    'Top row takeaway — max 20 words.',
    'Bottom row takeaway — max 20 words.',
    'Recommended action — max 20 words.'
  );
  slideNum(s, N);
}
```

### STAT CARDS ROW (5 headline numbers)
**Rules:** Alternating purple / black cards. Large bold number, 14pt label below.
Stat label: max 4 words per line, 2 lines. Rewrite if longer.

```javascript
[
  { num: '9.1×', lbl: 'Stat label\nmax 4 words', color: C.purple },
  { num: 'R18',  lbl: 'Stat label\nmax 4 words', color: '1A1A1A' },
  { num: '95%',  lbl: 'Stat label\nmax 4 words', color: C.purple },
  { num: '84%',  lbl: 'Stat label\nmax 4 words', color: '1A1A1A' },
  { num: '24%',  lbl: 'Stat label\nmax 4 words', color: C.purple },
].forEach((st, i) => {
  const xx = 0.2 + i * 2.6;
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, {
    x: xx, y: 0.95, w: 2.48, h: 2.0,
    fill: { color: st.color }, line: { color: st.color }, rectRadius: 0.1
  });
  s.addText(st.num, {
    x: xx+0.12, y: 1.05, w: 2.24, h: 0.9,
    fontSize: 30, bold: true,
    color: st.color === C.purple ? C.white : C.purple,
    fontFace: TF, align: 'center'
  });
  s.addText(st.lbl, {
    x: xx+0.1, y: 1.98, w: 2.28, h: 0.8,
    fontSize: 14, color: C.white,   // 14pt floor
    fontFace: BF, align: 'center', wrap: true
  });
});
```

### RECOMMENDATION SLIDE (evidence panel + 4 action cards)
**Rules:** Smaller title (18pt). Evidence text: 14pt. Action card body: 14pt.
All text ≥ 14pt. If copy won't fit, rewrite shorter.

```javascript
{
  const s = pptx.addSlide();
  logoMark(s);

  s.addText('Recommendation title — max 15 words, keep under 120 characters.', {
    x: 0.35, y: 0.05, w: 11.7, h: 0.55,
    fontSize: 18, bold: true, color: C.purple, fontFace: TF, wrap: true
  });
  s.addText('Section Label  |  Context — max 8 words', {
    x: 0.35, y: 0.62, w: 11.7, h: 0.26,
    fontSize: 14, italic: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF
  });

  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: 0.2, y: 0.92, w: 6.0, h: 4.78,
    fill: { color: C.offwhite }, line: { color: C.grey, pt: 1 }
  });
  s.addText('The Evidence Case', {
    x: 0.35, y: 1.0, w: 5.7, h: 0.3,
    fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.black, fontFace: BF
  });
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: 0.35, y: 1.32, w: 5.7, h: 0.012,
    fill: { color: 'CCCCCC' }, line: { color: 'CCCCCC' }
  });

  // Evidence points: 14pt. Max 1 sentence each. Lead with a number or fact.
  ['Evidence point 1 — 1 sentence, lead with data.',
   'Evidence point 2 — 1 sentence, lead with data.',
   'Evidence point 3 — 1 sentence, lead with data.',
   'Evidence point 4 — 1 sentence, lead with data.',
   'Evidence point 5 — 1 sentence, lead with data.',
  ].forEach((txt, i) => {
    const yy = 1.44 + i * 0.84;
    s.addShape(pptx.shapes.OVAL, {
      x: 0.35, y: yy+0.04, w: 0.34, h: 0.34,
      fill: { color: '1A1A1A' }, line: { color: '1A1A1A' }
    });
    s.addText(String(i+1).padStart(2,'0'), {
      x: 0.35, y: yy+0.04, w: 0.34, h: 0.34,
      fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.white, align: 'center', fontFace: BF
    });
    s.addText(txt, {
      x: 0.82, y: yy, w: 5.2, h: 0.72,
      fontSize: 14, color: C.black, fontFace: BF, wrap: true  // 14pt floor
    });
  });

  // Action cards: body 14pt. Max 2 sentences. Rewrite if longer.
  [
    { n:'1', title:'Action One',   body:'2 sentences max. Lead with the verb.', color: C.purple },
    { n:'2', title:'Action Two',   body:'2 sentences max. Lead with the verb.', color: '1A1A1A' },
    { n:'3', title:'Action Three', body:'2 sentences max. Lead with the verb.', color: C.purple },
    { n:'4', title:'Action Four',  body:'2 sentences max. Lead with the verb.', color: '1A1A1A' },
  ].forEach((a, i) => {
    const xx = 6.4 + (i%2)*3.45;
    const yy = 0.92 + Math.floor(i/2)*2.42;
    s.addShape(pptx.shapes.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, {
      x: xx, y: yy, w: 3.3, h: 2.2,
      fill: { color: a.color }, line: { color: a.color }, rectRadius: 0.1
    });
    s.addShape(pptx.shapes.OVAL, {
      x: xx+0.15, y: yy+0.12, w: 0.46, h: 0.46,
      fill: { color: a.color===C.purple ? C.white : '875EFA' },
      line: { color: a.color===C.purple ? C.white : '875EFA' }
    });
    s.addText(a.n, {
      x: xx+0.15, y: yy+0.12, w: 0.46, h: 0.46,
      fontSize: 14, bold: true,
      color: a.color===C.purple ? C.purple : C.white,
      align: 'center', fontFace: TF
    });
    s.addText(a.title, {
      x: xx+0.15, y: yy+0.68, w: 2.98, h: 0.44,
      fontSize: 14, bold: true, color: C.white, fontFace: TF, wrap: true
    });
    s.addText(a.body, {
      x: xx+0.15, y: yy+1.16, w: 2.98, h: 0.88,
      fontSize: 14, color: a.color===C.purple ? C.white : 'CCCCCC',  // 14pt floor
      fontFace: BF, wrap: true
    });
  });

  insightBar(s,
    'Headline recommendation — max 20 words.',
    'Strategic implication — max 20 words.',
    'Risk or watch point — max 20 words.',
    'Recommended action — max 20 words.'
  );
  slideNum(s, N);
}
```

### THANK YOU SLIDE
**Rules:** Full wordmark top-left. NO logo mark. No slide number. Lime stripe at bottom.

```javascript
{
  const s = pptx.addSlide();
  s.addImage({ path: LOGO, x: 0.35, y: 0.28, w: 2.5, h: 1.1 });
  s.addText('Thank you.', {
    x: 0, y: 2.7, w: 13.33, h: 1.8,
    fontSize: 64, bold: true, color: C.purple, align: 'center', fontFace: TF
  });
  s.addText('weaverfintech.com', {
    x: 0, y: 6.7, w: 13.33, h: 0.38,
    fontSize: 14, color: C.black, align: 'center', fontFace: BF  // 14pt floor
  });
  s.addShape(pptx.shapes.RECTANGLE, {
    x: 0, y: 7.28, w: 13.33, h: 0.22,
    fill: { color: C.lime }, line: { color: C.lime }
  });
}
```

---

## Slide Structure Rules

| Rule | Detail |
|------|--------|
| Logo mark | Top-right (`x:12.55, y:0.08, w:0.62, h:0.62`) on every slide **except** first and last |
| Full wordmark | Top-left (`x:0.35, y:0.28, w:2.5, h:1.1`) on first and last slides only |
| Slide number | Bottom-right on every slide except first and last. **Exception to 14pt rule: 9pt** |
| Title font | 20pt bold purple for content slides; 44pt for title slide; 52pt for dividers |
| Subtitle | **14pt** italic black, directly below title |
| Minimum font size | **14pt floor** on ALL text except slide numbers. Never go below. Rewrite copy instead. |
| Photos | Always natural aspect ratio — never stretch. Use pre-calculated widths. Right-anchor: `x = 13.33 - render_w` |
| Insight bar | Every analytical content slide. `y:5.72, h:1.78`. Light grey bg + purple left accent |
| Chart panels | `chartBox()` helper always — offwhite fill, grey border, **14pt** bold title, grey rule |
| Chart colours | Primary series: `875EFA` purple. Secondary: `1A1A1A` black. Third: `C4FF00` lime |
| Slide order | Title → Divider → Content × N → Divider → Content × N → ... → Thank You |

---

## Insight Bar Copy Rules

The insight bar must answer **"So what?"** — never just describe the data.

- **Headline** (bold, 14pt): One sentence, **max 20 words**. States what the data means + what it demands.
- **Strategic implication** (14pt): The consequence or opportunity this creates for the business. **Max 20 words.**
- **Risk or watch point** (14pt): The dependency, constraint, or risk that could undermine the opportunity. **Max 20 words.**
- **Recommended action** (14pt): The specific decision, next step, or escalation required. **Max 20 words.**

If any of these exceed 20 words at 14pt: **cut the words, not the font.**

## QA Checklist (run before delivering every deck)

```bash
npm install pptxgenjs
node setup.js          # write logos to disk (once per session)
node your_script.js    # generate the deck
```

Inspect every slide for:
- [ ] Logo mark top-right on slides 2 through N-1 (not first, not last)
- [ ] Full wordmark top-left on slide 1 and last slide only
- [ ] No photo stretching or warping
- [ ] Slide titles fit — no overflow, no truncation
- [ ] **No text below 14pt** (slide numbers are the only exception)
- [ ] **All long copy was rewritten shorter — font size was never reduced below 14pt**
- [ ] Insight bar on every analytical/chart slide
- [ ] Insight bar answers "So what?" not data narration
- [ ] Slide numbers bottom-right on all content slides
- [ ] All colours match brand hex exactly
- [ ] No placeholder text remaining
- [ ] Charts visible and labelled
- [ ] Font is Axiforma throughout (check fallback isn't showing)
- [ ] File saves as `.pptx`

---

## Common Errors to Avoid

| Error | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| Font below 14pt | REWRITE the copy shorter — never reduce font size below 14pt |
| Font is Aptos or Calibri | Change TF and BF to `'Axiforma'`; ensure font is installed |
| Stretched/warped photos | Use pre-calculated `render_w` values. Never use `sizing: { type: 'contain' }` |
| Slide title overflows | Shorten to ≤ 12 words — never reduce below 20pt |
| Logo mark on title/thank-you | Only call `logoMark(s)` on slides 2 through N-1 |
| Logo mark missing on content slides | Call `logoMark(s)` at the top of every content/divider block |
| Dark insight bar | Use `C.insightbg` (`EFEFEF`) — light grey, not black |
| Divider title hyphenates | Shorten or use `fontSize: 46` |
| Inventing new colours | Only use the 9 colours in `C` |
| Missing slide numbers | Call `slideNum(s, N)` on every slide except first and last |
| Photos not found | Check GitHub raw URL — ensure repo is public and path is correct |
| Logos not found | Run `node setup.js` at the start of every session |
